v2_origin.extracted_from: density-voids.js (v1, meta.version=8) — same detect-rasterize-flood-rim pipeline, but v2 grew owner-claim + post-RANSAC re-emission of owner/plane-equations (commit d5bd492, 2026-04-18). density-voids-2.js (created in commit 835c50a, 2026-04-19) was forked to drop the owner dependency so it could run BEFORE segmentation as a pre-GSR seed source for grow-refit-merge.

summary: Pre-GSR ghost-plane seed detection. Rasterizes building points on a horizontal grid (XZ in y-up, XY in z-up), finds low-density patches via core-anchored 4-connected flood fill, dilates a Chebyshev rim around each surviving void, and RANSAC-fits a plane through rim-and-interior-survivor candidates pre-filtered by per-point normal tilt (drops walls and near-horizontal ground). Surviving fits are emitted as ghost-planes-2 with hull lifted onto each ghost equation. The canonical use case is south-facing slate dropout on dahouet, where specular solar reflection wipes out most returns and conventional segmentation never sees the plane; the void IS the signal. Designed to run pre-segmentation so grow-refit-merge consumes ghost equations as first-class seeds rather than grafting them on after the fact.

phases.name: Horizontal bounds + grid sizing
phases.description: Compute (h0, h1) min/max over the per-building point pool (h0/h1 are the two non-up axes selected by up_axis: y-up → XZ, z-up → XY). Pad by one cell, compute cols/rows from cell_size.

phases.name: Rasterize (CSR)
phases.description: Bin each pool point into a cell, build CSR offsets + per-cell point lists. cell_size defaults to max(0.3, 2/√density); auto-derived from per-bldg `bldg-thresholds.density` (single source of truth) when density param is left at the sentinel −1.

phases.name: Occupancy + core cells
phases.description: OCCUPIED = count ≥ occupiedMinCount. CORE = empty cell with ≥ coreMinEmpty empty 8-neighbors. coreMinEmpty=6 rejects 1- and 2-cell-wide scan-stripe gaps (which have at most 5 empty 8-neighbors), keeping only real dropout patches.

phases.name: Core-anchored 4-connected flood fill
phases.description: Seed BFS from core cells; propagate ONLY through cores. Non-core empty cells get absorbed as terminal 1-hop halo but don't themselves spread. Effect: a stripe gap attached to a real void absorbs exactly one stripe cell and stops — no bleed along stripe lines.

phases.name: Prune + reindex
phases.description: Drop components with < minVoidCells cells; reindex the survivors into a dense [0..n_voids) range.

phases.name: Chebyshev rim extraction
phases.description: For each void cell, dilate a Chebyshev ball of radius rimDilation. Each touched occupied cell records its min Chebyshev distance and owning void id (closest-wins). Also records void cell centers (h0, h1) per void for the hull step.

phases.name: Candidate pools with normal pre-filter
phases.description: Two pools per void. Rim pass: occupied cells in the rim band contribute points; inner pool is the dist==1 rim ring. Interior-survivor pass: cells INSIDE the void with 0 < count < occupiedMinCount also contribute — those points sit directly on the ghost plane. Each candidate is normal-pre-filtered: |normal[up]| ∈ [roofTiltMin, roofTiltMax] keeps roof-tilt-like points and drops walls (|ny| near 0) and near-flat ground (|ny| near 1). NO owner dependency (unlike v1 density-voids) — this step runs before any segmentation exists.

phases.name: RANSAC + LSQ refit per void
phases.description: Per void with ≥ minFitPts inner candidates, run ransacIterations of 3-point cross-product plane RANSAC against distThreshold. If ≥ minInliers inliers, LSQ-refit on the inlier set (keeping the RANSAC plane on degenerate refit). RANSAC uses the bit-faithful v7-mulberry32 PRNG so inlier sequences match v2's exactly. The RANSAC pool is the inner ring only — widening it to the full Chebyshev band lets distant ground/wall points dominate (a known failure mode: pulled a dahouet void from 43° to 0.8° tilt; see commit d5bd492 rationale).

phases.name: Build ghost-planes-2 + viz blob
phases.description: For each fit with |normal[up]| ≥ minNormalY, compute the convex hull of the void's cell centers (monotone chain), lift each hull vertex onto the plane equation, and emit a ghost-plane record carrying normal/d/tilt/azimuth/rms, void_id, area = n_cells·cell_size², LOCAL inlier_indices, and the 3D hull. The 2D viz blob (counts grid, void_ids grid, rim_mask, per-rim-point classification: inlier/survivor/dist/filtered) is gated by emitVizArtifacts.

parameters.name: cellSize
parameters.summary: Horizontal grid cell size. 0 → derive from density: max(0.3, 2/√density).
parameters.rationale: ~2× point spacing keeps cells coarse enough that a single missing-point cell is statistically significant but fine enough to resolve typical roof-face dropout patches. Lower bound 0.3 m guards against pathologically dense data where 2/√density falls below sensor noise scale.

parameters.name: density
parameters.summary: Tile/building point density. Sentinel −1 → look up from per-bldg `bldg-thresholds` artifact.
parameters.rationale: Centralized via v7-derive-thresholds (commit 4ac68ab, 2026-05-16) so density and dist_threshold derive identically across DV2, GRM, boundary-topology. v3-prod's extract-buildings reduces the working set to per-bldg points (16092 pts on dahouet) so per-bldg density (19.872 pts/m²) calibrates cell-size correctly; pinning the impl default to 25 would over-coarsen.

parameters.name: distThreshold
parameters.summary: RANSAC inlier distance threshold. Per-bldg auto from `bldg-thresholds.dist_threshold_seed` when 0/unset.
parameters.rationale: = 4.5 × σ_z(0.02). Matches the seed-side threshold used by the rest of the v7 chain (v2 derives identically via deriveDistThreshold(zNoise)). Tighter than GRM's grow threshold because ghost-plane fits start from a heterogeneous rim cloud and need to reject more aggressively.

parameters.name: occupiedMinCount
parameters.summary: Min points per cell to be OCCUPIED.
parameters.rationale: Default 2 treats single-point cells as empty so voids fill out cleanly. Lone survivors inside a dropout zone are the strongest signal that a ghost plane exists — they must NOT plug their own cell or the void fragments.

parameters.name: coreMinEmpty
parameters.summary: Min empty 8-neighbors for an empty cell to be a CORE.
parameters.rationale: 1- and 2-cell-wide scan-stripe gaps (a different LiDAR artifact) have at most 5 empty 8-neighbors per cell. coreMinEmpty=6 rejects them; real dropout patches have 7–8.

parameters.name: minVoidCells
parameters.summary: Discard void components smaller than this many cells.
parameters.rationale: Smallest real dropout zone on dahouet is ~10 cells at ~0.4 m cell size (≈1.6 m²). 8 is a slight margin below.

parameters.name: rimDilation
parameters.summary: Chebyshev rim band width around void cells.
parameters.rationale: 1 = immediate 8-neighbor ring (≈ inner-only pool); 2 picks up a thicker outer band. Used for the 2D viz + (in v1 density-voids) a separate outer pool for plane-claim evidence. DV2 only RANSACs the inner ring — see phase 8 rationale.

parameters.name: minFitPts
parameters.summary: Min inner candidates required to attempt RANSAC for a void.
parameters.rationale: Below this RANSAC's 3-point sampling on a tiny candidate set degenerates into LSQ-on-everything; 10 is the empirical floor where the sampling actually explores hypotheses.

parameters.name: ransacIterations
parameters.rationale: Inherited from v2 _ransacPlaneGlobal default. Sufficient for the typical 10–80 candidate pools at the ~50% inlier ratio seen on dahouet ghost voids.

parameters.name: minInliers
parameters.summary: Min RANSAC inliers for a fit to be accepted.
parameters.rationale: Below 6 the LSQ refit is rank-degenerate in practice for plane fits with realistic noise.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.rationale: Fixed for reproducibility. v7-mulberry32 self-checks the first 10 outputs against V8 reference values, so v3 inlier sequences match v2's bit-for-bit.

parameters.name: minNormalY
parameters.summary: Min |normal[up_axis]| for hull lifting / ghost emission.
parameters.rationale: Hull lift solves p[up] = −(n·p_horiz + d)/n[up]; |n[up]| < 0.15 makes this numerically unstable AND signals a near-vertical fit unlikely to be a roof plane. Drops these as invalid ghosts.

parameters.name: roofTiltMin
parameters.summary: Min |normal[up]| of candidate points to qualify for the inner/outer pools. Set to 0 to disable.
parameters.rationale: Excludes wall-like points (|ny| near 0) bleeding into the rim from adjacent walls. Without this, RANSAC on a rim that mixes wall + roof-tilt points often locks onto the wall.

parameters.name: roofTiltMax
parameters.summary: Max |normal[up]| of candidate points. Set to 1 to disable.
parameters.rationale: Excludes near-flat ground bleeding in from below the eave. Symmetric with roofTiltMin on the other end of the tilt spectrum.

parameters.name: upAxis
parameters.summary: Up axis index (1 = y-up bench frame; 2 = z-up LAZ production frame).
parameters.rationale: Wrapper sets up_axis=2 (z-up) for v3 prod. The impl default is 1 (y-up) so the bench harness can byte-cmp against v2 dumps directly. Affects rasterization (uses the two non-up components), normal filtering (reads n[up]), and hull lift (solves for p[up]).

parameters.name: emitVizArtifacts
parameters.summary: Emit the bulky 2D viz blob (counts grid + rim arrays + per-void summary).
parameters.rationale: Mirrors v7-hemisphere-segment's emit-viz gate. Off in production runs to save serialization cost; on in the lab UI for the dv2-viz-2d inspector SVG (viz/dv2-viz-2d.viz.js).

reads.name: per-building-records
reads.description: Per-building record (schema header + global point indices into lidar-positions).

reads.name: building-local-frames
reads.description: Per-building F64×3 centroid used to centroid-shift positions for the per-bldg F32→F64 cast (matches hemisphere-segment's byte-consistency convention).

reads.name: ts-normals
reads.description: Per-building F32×3·n_pts unit normals from v7-tile-signals, used by the per-point roofTilt pre-filter.

reads.name: bldg-thresholds
reads.description: Per-building density + dist_threshold_seed/grm + z_noise. Sourced when density/distThreshold params are unset.

reads.name: ts-weights
reads.description: Per-building F32 per-point density weight (Voronoi cell area π·d_k²/k) from v7-tile-signals. Wired 0c3e28a (2026-05-28); area-weights the post-RANSAC LS refit of each ghost plane. NOTE: the RANSAC itself (v7_ransac_plane) stays UNWEIGHTED — uniform sampling + inlier-count scoring — per the selective-weighting rule (journal 2026-03-15-v7-compare-segmentation-arena §4.0: never weight RANSAC sampling/scoring). Only the refit is weighted. REQUIRED — the fit primitive aborts on NULL.

writes.name: dv2-ghost-planes
writes.description: Per-building ARRAY_INLINE of ghost-plane records. 104-byte fixed-stride header (normal, d, tilt, azimuth, rms, centroid, area, void_id, inlier_count, hull_vert_count, reserved) followed by hull_vert_count×F64×3 hull verts and inlier_count×U32 LOCAL inlier_indices (into the building's point slice). Consumed by v7-grow-refit-merge as an additional seed source.

writes.name: dv2-viz-2d
writes.description: Per-building ARRAY_INLINE viz blob (debug visibility). Fixed 56 B header (bounds, cell_size, cols, rows, rim_dilation, n_points) + counts grid (Int32) + void_ids grid (Int16) + rim_mask grid (U8) + per-void summary (120 B/record) + per-rim-point arrays (XY positions + void_id/inlier/survivor/dist/filtered flags). Rendered by viz/dv2-viz-2d.viz.js. Gated by emitVizArtifacts.

v3_divergences.topic: Dropped tile-wide `lidar-density` + `lidar-z-noise` artifact reads in favour of per-bldg `bldg-thresholds`
v3_divergences.rationale: v2 reads tile-wide artifacts and derives cellSize/distThreshold internally. v3-prod's extract-buildings reduces the working set to a per-bldg subset (16092 pts on dahouet); per-bldg density/z_noise from v7-derive-thresholds calibrates DV2 to its actual operating set. Pipeline params still override per-bldg, with sentinel −1 meaning 'auto from bldg-thresholds'. Initial port (commit 4515a4e) baked density=25 + distThreshold=0.09 as static defaults; 4ac68ab replaced that with the per-bldg source. Bumped step version 1 → 2.

v3_divergences.topic: Output artifact rename: density-voids-2-2d → dv2-viz-2d, ghost-planes-2 → dv2-ghost-planes
v3_divergences.rationale: Phase 1 eager rename pass — v3 artifact names are step-prefixed for unambiguous wiring. Lab UI viz files map back to the v2 bare-name for the inline SVG renderer.

Same pure-compute impl serves both the bench harness (up_axis=1, y-up, byte-cmp against v2 dump) and the production wrapper (up_axis=2, z-up LAZ frame). Affects raster axes, normal-filter axis, and hull-lift axis. v2 was y-up-only.
Mirrors v7-hemisphere-segment's emit-viz pattern. The 2D viz blob is bulky (counts/void_ids grids scale as cols·rows + rim arrays scale as n_rim); production runs skip it for serialization savings.

v3_divergences.topic: Inlier indices stored LOCAL to building, not global
v3_divergences.rationale: v3 per-bldg ARRAY_INLINE format stores indices into the building's point slice. v2's tile-wide step emitted global indices. Visualizers/consumers resolve LOCAL→3D via the sibling per-building-records + lidar-positions.

related.summary: Two-session physics modeling effort to predict where slate-dropout will occur (beam incidence + solar bisector + specular BRDF). All fits hit the absolute S/N paradox: standard link budget says dropout shouldn't happen. Conclusion: physics prediction is intractable; the geometric workaround (find the void shape and fit a plane through the rim) is what DV2 implements.
First-session physics modeling — cos(θ_i) signal × SNR-degradation noise model on 14 plane samples. RMSE 1.95 with per-building D₀ but fails on ghost_SE.
Background research on slate optics + LiDAR detection theory feeding the physics model attempts.
v1 density-voids: original XZ-density-dropout step. Established the rasterize → occupancy → core cells → core-anchored flood → rim → RANSAC pipeline that DV2 inherits unchanged.

v1 density-voids v8: split inner/outer candidate pools, owner-claim for connex planes, post-claim LSQ refit + ejection, re-emit owner/plane-equations. Established the inner-only-for-RANSAC rule that DV2 keeps (widening pulled a dahouet void from tilt 43° to 0.8°).

v2 density-voids-2 created. Forked from density-voids to drop the owner dependency so detection can run BEFORE segmentation. Added the per-point roofTilt normal pre-filter to compensate for losing the owner-based wall/ground rejection. ghost-planes-2 reads as extra seeds in grow-refit-merge — wires into the main v7 path.

v3 Phase 5.4 port — v7-density-voids-2. Byte-identical against v2 dump: 5/5 ghost planes match, all field diffs ≤ 1e-15. Introduces v7-mulberry32 + v7-ransac-plane shared primitives (RNG-call pattern preserved bit-for-bit so inlier sequences match v2's).
v3 step_version 1 → 2: migrated from sentinel-auto density-compute to per-bldg `bldg-thresholds` consumption. Centralizes density/dist_threshold across DV2 + GRM + boundary-topology.
v7 port plan — DV2 sits between normal-cascade-seed and grow-refit-merge in the main segmentation path. Notes that DV2 was in active v2 iteration at port time.
Threshold-investigation log: per-bldg density vs tile-wide on dahouet, validates DV2's per-bldg consumption against v2 bldgonly TCBD (19.872 pts/m²).

Canonical dahouet test case: 7 slate roof planes at 45° tilt, south-facing planes (bay_cat P16, zero_gap P16) lose 35:1 of their points to specular dropout. ghost_SE plane has 10 P15 / 0 P16 points and is the textbook DV2 target (recovered as void #1 in commit 835c50a's run, 60/73 RANSAC inliers).

open_questions: Should DV2 widen the RANSAC pool past the inner ring once roofTilt-pre-filtering is in place? The d5bd492 rationale (wide pool dragged a dahouet void from 43° to 0.8°) predates the normal pre-filter — with walls/ground rejected per-point, the failure mode may be neutralized and a wider pool could rescue voids that lack enough inner-ring inliers.

Is the cell-size floor of 0.3 m still right for the per-bldg density regime (19–30 pts/m² typical)? Auto formula gives ≈0.36–0.40 m here, so the floor never kicks in on real cases; it only matters for synthetic high-density inputs.

Should ghost-plane RANSAC use weighted sampling biased toward interior-survivor points? They sit directly on the ghost plane (highest inlier confidence) and could anchor the hypothesis better than rim points (heterogeneous mix of adjacent planes).

Should the roofTilt band be auto-derived from each building's normal-cascade tilt histogram rather than fixed at [0.20, 0.98]? Wide-eave buildings on dahouet (45° slate) sit at |ny|≈0.71, comfortably inside the band, but the band would be wrong for flatter Mediterranean tile roofs.

DV2 has no claim mechanism (intentionally — it precedes segmentation). If a void's recovered ghost equation duplicates a normal-cascade seed within GRM's coplanar threshold, the duplicate seeds get merged in iter 1 anyway. Worth measuring duplicate-merge rate to confirm DV2 isn't just emitting noise that GRM filters out.
